body: fragment CourierWork on Courier { availability currentDelivery { id orderId stage } id offers { deliveryId expiresAt id orderId } } mutation ApplyCourierDeliveryAction($action: CourierDeliveryAction!, $deliveryId: ID!) { applyCourierDeliveryAction(deliveryId: $deliveryId, action: $action) { courier { ...CourierWork } problem } }
